bilingual.notes: Bilingual education endorsement (NDAC code 24500) — ELD endorsement requirements plus methods of teaching bilingual education and 16 semester hours in a language other than English OR documented proficiency in a language other than English.

eld.notes: English Learner (EL) Endorsement (NDAC code 24000) — 16 semester hours across foundations/multicultural ed, linguistics, methods of teaching ESL, assessment of culturally diverse students, and field experience. Praxis ESOL is an alternative pathway in lieu of full coursework. ND is a WIDA member; the state ELP assessment is WIDA ACCESS for ELLs. ND adopted the Seal of Biliteracy in 2019 (NDSB, operated by NDDPI). Schema does not currently have dedicated fields for ELP assessment or Seal of Biliteracy; these facts are recorded here and in sources/ND/2026-05-08/changes-from-baseline.md.

history.title: North Dakota Seal of Biliteracy adopted
history.description: NDDPI adopted the North Dakota State Seal of Biliteracy in 2019, recognizing high school graduates who demonstrate proficiency in English plus one or more additional languages. Operated by NDDPI; first awards issued the 2019-20 school year.

history.title: Re-verified against current ND ESPB and NDDPI sources
history.description: Re-confirmed NDAC ch. 67.1-02-03 EL and Bilingual endorsement requirements (16 sem. hrs. + Praxis ESOL alternative), ND ESPB adoption of InTASC Model Core Teaching Standards (Aug. 2015 final), and NDDPI's continued WIDA membership using ACCESS for ELLs. elPercent set to 3.3 (NCES Table 204.20, fall 2021). No substantive credential changes from baseline.
